relations.product: replacement steam generators for EDF's pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants in France
relations.quote: MHI has received orders for a total of 9 replacement SGs from EDF, and the remaining 6 units are currently being manufactured at MHI's Kobe facilities, with delivery scheduled from 2028 onwards.
relations.label: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: MHI Delivers Three Replacement Steam Generators for EDF's (10-15-2026)

relations.product: retrofit of Darajat Geothermal Power Plant Unit 3 (steam turbines; output raised from 121 MW to 129 MW) and a Technical Study and Cooperation Agreement
relations.quote: has completed the retrofit of Unit 3 at the Darajat Geothermal Power Plant in Indonesia, owned by local geothermal power producer Star Energy Geothermal Darajat II, Limited (SEG), and commenced commercial operation.
relations.label: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: Mitsubishi Power Completes Retrofit of Darajat Geothermal (10-20-2026)
